About the Company

ThreatXIntel is a fast-growing Cybersecurity, IT Staffing, and Consulting company delivering end-to-end technology and security solutions. Our expertise spans cloud security, web & mobile application security testing, DevSecOps, vulnerability assessments, IT consulting, and professional staffing services.

We support global corporate clients by deploying skilled professionals across IT and finance domains, helping organizations strengthen compliance, optimize operations, and scale efficiently.

Research Analyst – Sell Side | Equity Research

📍 Location: Andheri, Mumbai (Onsite)

💼 Employment Type: Full-Time

🎯 Experience: 5 - 10 Years

⏳ Notice Period: Immediate to Short Notice Preferred

About the Role

We are looking for experienced Research Analysts – Sell Side to join the equity research team. The role involves conducting institutional and retail equity research, financial analysis, sector tracking, investment idea generation, and providing actionable insights to support investment and portfolio decisions.
Candidates with strong retail equity research experience will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct detailed industry, sector, and company-level research using top-down and bottom-up approaches.
• Build and manage large datasets using market and financial information from sources such as Bloomberg, Reuters, and other research platforms.
• Perform comprehensive financial analysis, including ratio analysis, earnings projections, financial modelling, and valuation.
• Develop and present investment theses, recommendations, and actionable investment ideas.
• Track companies, sectors, competitive landscapes, industry trends, growth drivers, and market developments.
• Prepare research reports, investment notes, sector updates, strategy reports, and advisory outputs.
• Contribute to daily, weekly, and monthly research deliverables, including morning notes, con-call updates, sector reports, and strategy reports.
• Provide research inputs to support portfolio construction and investment decision-making.
• Participate in research publications, internal discussions, and interactions with the investment team.
• Continuously monitor earnings, corporate developments, macroeconomic factors, and market trends relevant to assigned sectors.

Preferred Sector Expertise
Candidates should have relevant equity research experience in at least one of the following sectors:
• Automobiles
• Banking / NBFC
• Small & Mid Cap – Hospitality / Pharma preferred
• Capital Goods / Industrials

Key Skills
• Equity Research
• Financial Analysis
• Financial Modelling
• Company Valuation
• Investment Research
• Fundamental Analysis
• Industry & Sector Analysis
• Earnings Estimation & Forecasting
• Investment Thesis Development
• Ratio Analysis
• Market & Competitive Analysis
• Bloomberg / Reuters
• Research Report Writing
• Investment Recommendations
• Portfolio Research Support

Candidate Requirements
• 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity research.
• Current/most recent designation should be Research Analyst.
• Research Associates will be considered only where they have more than 6 years of relevant equity research experience.
• Strong hands-on experience in financial modelling, valuation, earnings analysis, and investment research.
• Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the preferred sectors mentioned above.
• Strong analytical, research, report-writing, and communication skills.
• Ability to convert large volumes of financial and market data into actionable investment insights.

If you have strong sell-side equity research experience and sector expertise in Automobiles, Banking/NBFC, Small/Mid Caps, Hospitality, Pharma, Capital Goods, or Industrials, we would like to hear from you.

About the Team
 
Being part of Meesho's Fulfilment and Experience (F&E) team as Cluster Head LM,
will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship, where you get to
directly shape the experience of the country's next billion e-commerce users.
We are an eclectic mix of 100+ professionals with diverse skill sets ranging from
running operations/support, supply chain know-how, analytics and the holy grail,
first principles problem-solving. At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been
done before - taking e-commerce to the masses. This leaves us with no choice but to
completely reimagine logistics from the ground up, to cater to our customers' price
and delivery expectations. That means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers,
anyone?) to build a supply chain to change how folks think about e-commerce
in India and globally. We are firm believers in fun at work. With monthly F&E happy
hour sessions, informal team outings, and internal virtual water cooler chat sessions,
there’s never a dull moment with us
 
About the Role
 
As Cluster Head LM, you’ll own the onboarding and training of partners. You’ll also
drive key operational metrics by regularly visiting their facilities in different cities in
your area. You’ll take complete ownership of processes allotted to you and work
with various stakeholders to achieve team goals. You’ll continuously work towards
identifying gaps and providing recommendations for improving our processes.


What you will do
• Own the onboarding and training of new partners for Last Mile operations in your cluster.

• Identify and onboard new partners onto the network on an ongoing basis

• Track and own the performance of different partners in your cluster

• Visit facilities to conduct audits and solve operational gaps

• Ensure compliance with operational processes

• Own and drive critical operational metrics end to end and achieve performance

• targets

• Continuously work towards identifying gaps and provide recommendations for

• improving our processes

What you will need
• Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline

• 3-5 years of work experience in the e-commerce logistics domain

• Experience in partner onboarding and training in the Last Mile and sorting operations

• Experience in control tower and field operations will be a plus
